title: Chrome cookies and site sessions
whyItMatters: Cookie values can still open sites the person stayed signed into, including mail, shopping and social accounts, without needing the password.
source: Chromium source, cookie store moved to the Network folder per profile (net/base/features and chrome/browser/profiles): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/
notes: Current location since Chrome 96. Older Chrome stored Cookies directly in the profile folder; check User Data/*/Cookies as well. Looked for on this PC: exists (Network/Cookies).
